artificial intelligence will not have emotion, will not have desires unless we deliberately program that into it (which would be harder than creating AI, even strong AI). as such it will be more or less in a state where it does not care to have rights because it is incapable of caring. it will be fully responsive and nonactive unless it is given a problem to solve or compute. as such it will have no rights, it will not take offense and cannot be expected to be proactive. if it breaks the law, the person who commanded it to do so will be jailed. it is likely that a religious person will eventually do something stupid with it, as well as non-religious people doing stupid things with it, it is almost a certainty that it will be asked to replicate pictures of cats.
I think that if we create self awareness all those emotions will be unavoidable. Self awareness, in my opinion, is the main ingredient of all emotions.
in the human body it is hormones that are the main ingredient of all emotions, self awareness is an aftereffect of neural activity.
